donor: Existing study-specific donor alias; not linkable across studies.
visit: GSE280982 visit code: 1 pre, 2 last radiation day, 3 six weeks; categorical.
treatment: Unchanged source treatment label; not a causal contrast.
compartment: Original study tissue or T-cell compartment.
subset: Total T, CD4, CD8 or original source-state subset.
cell_type: Original Wells cell_type annotation, without relabeling.
policy: Frozen assignment policy; displayed primary estimates use threshold.
weighting: Original cell/unique_clone weighting for repertoire summaries, or clone/cell weighting for prediction.
interval: Source endpoint pair; pre_to_last_radiation=P–R, last_radiation_to_6weeks=R–6w, pre_to_6weeks=P–6w.
status: Original support/analysis status; unavailable rows have no plotted distance.
source_available: Whether the registered external donor/tissue/visit has a matched source sample.
tcr_cells: GSE190905 primary-TRB-bearing cells in a visit.
unique_primary_trb: Distinct nucleotide CDR3/V/J primary-TRB identities before threshold filtering.
threshold_cells: Cells meeting the frozen RFU score threshold of 0.6.
rna_metadata_cells: Cells in the original RNA metadata for the visit.
d_clone: Receptor TV (nucleotide CDR3/V/J) on the common qualified universe; dimensionless [0,1].
d_group: RFU TV on the same universe and weighting; dimensionless [0,1].
aggregation_cancellation: Within-donor d_clone minus d_group; not a difference of group medians.
total_mass_before: Qualified cell mass at the first endpoint of the displayed cell-weighted pair.
total_mass_after: Qualified cell mass at the second endpoint of the displayed cell-weighted pair.
cell_coverage_before: Threshold-qualified / primary-TRB cells in the first endpoint's subset.
cell_coverage_after: Threshold-qualified / primary-TRB cells in the second endpoint's subset.
before_cells: Qualified cells in the first endpoint/subset under the stated policy.
after_cells: Qualified cells in the second endpoint/subset under the stated policy.
condition: cell: original cell weights; unique: unique receptor weights; depth: frozen draws; dominant_removed: frozen dominant-identity union removal.
rfu_tv: RFU TV per donor/condition; depth rows use the median of 50 existing technical draws.
low: Depth rows: 2.5th percentile of 50 saved draws (linear interpolation); otherwise equal to rfu_tv. Not a donor confidence interval.
high: Depth rows: 97.5th percentile of 50 saved draws (linear interpolation); otherwise equal to rfu_tv. Not a donor confidence interval.
replicates: Number of existing technical measurements summarized within one donor; not independent donors.
cells_per_visit: Frozen without-replacement draw size; 500 except D06=404. Blank when inapplicable.
retained_fraction_before: Fraction of first-visit qualified cells retained after the frozen removal; blank for technical draw summaries.
retained_fraction_after: Fraction of second-visit qualified cells retained after the frozen removal; blank for technical draw summaries.
seed: Original technical-draw seed retained for traceability; no new random draw is performed.
primary_TRB_cells: GSE280982 gene-expression-matched primary-TRB cells; blank when source unavailable.
qualified_cells: Threshold-qualified cells in the named external visit or Wells source annotation.
coverage: External qualified_cells / primary_TRB_cells; blank for missing visits.
gex_cells: Cells in the matched gene-expression visit registry.
qualified_receptors: Distinct qualified nucleotide CDR3/V/J receptor identities in the external visit.
qualified_RFUs: Distinct qualified RFUs in the external visit.
before_qualified_cells: Qualified count at the first external endpoint; blank if unavailable.
after_qualified_cells: Qualified count at the second external endpoint; blank if unavailable.
detection_min_cells: RFU detection floor in each endpoint: one cell for displayed persistence; five-cell sensitivity retained.
detected_union_RFUs: RFUs meeting the detection floor in at least one endpoint.
persistent_RFUs: RFUs meeting the detection floor in both endpoints.
persistent_without_shared_receptor: Persistent RFUs with no shared observed nucleotide CDR3/V/J identity across endpoints.
persistent_without_shared_receptor_fract: persistent_without_shared_receptor / persistent_RFUs; undefined if denominator is zero.
participants: Distinct donors within this frozen study/compartment/interval row; rows can reuse donors.
available_visits: Available visits in this frozen summary stratum.
sampling_unit: Original study sampling unit; reads, primary-TRB cells or GEX-matched primary-TRB cells. Never pooled.
depth_min: Minimum source depth before threshold filtering: all source reads for RP1-14, primary-TRB cells for GSE190905, GEX-matched primary-TRB cells for GSE280982.
depth_max: Maximum source depth before threshold filtering, using the same study-specific unit and universe as depth_min.
coverage_denominator: Original explicitly named universe for the coverage fraction.
coverage_min: Minimum frozen coverage fraction within the row.
coverage_max: Maximum frozen coverage fraction within the row.
receptor_TV_median: Frozen equal-donor median Receptor TV (nucleotide CDR3/V/J); observed value for n=1.
RFU_TV_median: Frozen equal-donor median RFU TV; observed value for n=1.
cancellation_median: Frozen median of within-donor aggregation cancellation, not difference of TV medians.
persistent_union_median: Frozen median persistent/union fraction at the explicitly recorded detection floor; not harmonized across studies.
persistence_detection: Original persistence detection rule; five reads for RP1-14 versus one cell for public cell data.
depth_RFU_TV_median: Original frozen depth-sensitivity summary; retained for traceability, not recomputed or pooled.
depth_scheme: Original source description of its depth sensitivity.
category: Published RFU-QTL, conditional-eQTL overlap, conditional-caQTL overlap, or same-variant both-layer overlap. Overlap categories are not additive.
variants: Unique variant count in this source evidence category.
denominator_variants: 623 published RFU-QTL variants used as the overlap search denominator.
target_class: Source direct_TCR_gene or non_TCR_gene label for expression targets; unclassified chromatin targets remain blank.
eqtl_records: Distinct conditional expression target/rank records after deduplicating RFU joins.
caqtl_records: Distinct conditional chromatin target/rank records after deduplicating RFU joins.
caqtl_targets: Semicolon-separated exact source chromatin-accessibility target identifiers.
rfu_count: Distinct associated RFUs for a variant; RFUs can recur across variant rows.
layer: Original eqtl or caqtl molecular evidence layer.
target: Exact source expression-gene or chromatin-peak identifier.
conditional_rank: Source conditional-signal rank, retained without reinterpretation.
conditional_pvalue: Reported conditional-association P value; no new testing.
conditional_beta: Original conditional effect estimate in the source study's units; not harmonized across layers.
conditional_se: Original conditional effect standard error in source units.
anchor_provenance: Source description of how its anchor was obtained.
evidence_tier: Frozen evidence tier; matrix uses A_same_variant_conditional_layers.
baseline_log_loss: Saved held-out log loss for TRBV/TRBJ/CDR3-length baseline; summary rows are equal-donor means.
extended_log_loss: Saved held-out log loss for baseline plus RFU; summary rows are equal-donor means.
delta_log_loss: extended_log_loss minus baseline_log_loss; positive is worse.
design: ordinary donor-held-out or purged donor-held-out with shared amino-acid CDR3/V/J identities removed from training.
donors: Distinct contributing donors for an RFU/context row, or six held-out donors for prediction summaries.
atlas_cells: All source atlas cells in the donor/tissue stratum, including zero-primary-TRB samples.
primary_trb_cells: Wells cells with eligible primary TRB; observed zero remains zero, missing atlas combinations remain blank.
threshold_fraction_of_primary_trb: threshold_cells / primary_trb_cells; undefined for zero primary TRB.
coverage_state: primary_TRB_observed, atlas_zero_primary_TRB, or no_atlas_sample; the latter is added only for the rectangular display grid.
atlas_donors: Distinct source atlas donors represented in the tissue, including zero-primary-TRB samples.
cells: Threshold-qualified Wells cells supporting the RFU.
tissues: Number of distinct source tissues with at least one qualified cell.
observed_receptors: Frozen Wells observed-identity count: amino-acid CDR3 plus available V call (V_UNKNOWN fallback), not the longitudinal nucleotide CDR3/V/J endpoint.
public_support_rule: True when an RFU has at least 50 qualified cells across at least four donors.
cell_types: Number of original source cell_type labels with at least one qualified cell for this RFU.
categories_observed: Number of detected source tissues or cell_type labels for the indicated breadth dimension.
rfus: Number of distinct RFUs supporting the source annotation or counted in the breadth bin.
dimension: tissues or cell_types; these are detection/support counts, not specificity tests.
